text_block_list.text:
Summer training camp begins today.
The Umamusume head to the special facility,
marking the start of their intensive training days.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: ...The "center of an era."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"I will never give up. I won't back down.
The one who will overtake Kita-chan's back is—!"

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: ...Ugh, so bright—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: "...The greatest obstacle to this dream is an Umamusume like Kiseki-san, who is striving just as hard for that very same throne."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Even so, I'm sure... if an even stronger rival
were to appear—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
――A horse girl who attained the radiance of the sun,
all without ever holding the desire to take center stage.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Always finding herself at the center of attention—an Umamusume truly chosen by the era.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer!
Over here! Over heeeere!"

The first day of summer training camp. ...Despite that,
at Kiseki's request, we were heading toward a bookstore near the camp lodge.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Because all the racing magazines come out today, you know?!
Right after the Takarazuka Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Every magazine will be writing endlessly about me! Plastering my photos all over! Why wouldn't I want to witness such a glorious sight right now?!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh heh...
Then feast your eyes upon this~!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Huuuh~???

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: This is all the coverage the Takarazuka Kinen gets~~?!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ai-chan's the feature in that magazine, too?!
And a massive special on Ai-chan in that one, too?!
choice_data_list: ...It's almost entirely an Almond Eye special feature.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
C-Come on, you're teasing me!
If it's a different magazine, then—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Is that Ai-chan?!

After checking through the shop shelves, I head back to the training camp.
I've looked through almost all of this month's magazines, but...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...I-It's all Almond-chan specials.
The cover, the lead feature, everything...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
This, that, everything...
Ai-chan's Oaks is the main focus of it all...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...——! Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Let's gather some input!
Since Ai-chan struck such a chord with the public,
all we have to do is steal her secret!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Let's go find out!
Just *what* she did to surpass my Takarazuka Kinen!

――Almond Eye.
Her race record: 5 starts, 4 wins.
At the Oka Sho, she blew past 15 Umamusume on the home stretch, defeating the favorite and Junior-tier champion Lucky Lilac to claim victory.

In her next race, the Oaks,
she clocked the field's fastest final three furlongs
at 33.2 seconds over the last 600 meters to claim a decisive victory.

These numbers show an overwhelming speed that completely outclasses
even the Umamusume running the Nippon Derby
at the same racecourse and distance in the same year.
Almond Eye possesses the exact numbers worthy of heralding the beginning of a legend.

Together with Kiseki,
we thoroughly look up every bit of information on Almond Eye.

"And every time I analyzed the data,
what I came to understand was..."

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"...'Already at the level of a Triple Tiara Umamusume—
no, a Classic Triple Crown Umamusume,'
'We are witnessing history right now.'"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"She has the caliber of the world's best!"
"A superstar is born! She is the undisputed strongest!"—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"...In the blink of an eye,
Ai-chan captured everyone's hearts—..."

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Everything I ever wanted, all at once.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...This is our chance!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
It just means a new rival has appeared!
Doesn't that just add another exciting element to the mix?!

Indeed.
I can understand why critics and officials hold her in such high regard.
I also understand their desire to feature her.

Still, Kiseki is an Umamusume who will surely surpass it.
She's the kind of Umamusume who thrills the crowd by challenging every wall!
choice_data_list: Your story is going to burn even brighter!
Your story is going to burn even brighter from here!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Having such a charismatic,
greatest rival makes things super exciting!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I wonder when I'll get to race against Ai-chan!
Could it be as soon as next time?!
choice_data_list: No, she's aiming for the Triple Tiara.
No, she's aiming for the Triple Tiara.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ah, right...!
Then in the autumn, I'll go for the Shuka Sho, so...
Any Umamusume on the Tiara route would likely run in the Queen Elizabeth II Cup after that. A rematch this year is improbable.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
That's a shame in its own right...
Next year at the earliest, huh...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Very well, then! Right now, I shall focus on my own challenge!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
First, to the Kyoto Daishoten!
Let's do tons of special training, okay?!

"And so, Kiseki burned with fighting spirit
toward the goal right in front of her:
the Autumn Senior Triple Crown."

Even if the day truly comes
where Kiseki clashes with Almond Eye...
I'm certain she will win.
First, let's give the summer training camp everything we've got!
